notes.notes:

notes.title: 🎫 Friend Pass Release Date & Important Pricing Info 🎫
notes.notes:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38882980/668885cb1e64635db1bf4d5dca691519575227af.png

Hello Tricksters! The time has come to share more details on Friend Pass, which will allow you to invite 7 friends into any online lobby through room code, without them needing to purchase Trivia Tricks!

We’re proud to announce that Friend Pass will be available on [strike]June 1st![/strike] (Friend Pass now launches on May 30th!) Here's a short video trailer we've put together going over the details of joining an online lobby as a free Friend Pass player!

[previewyoutube=lTwKdQaaVfI;full][/previewyoutube]
Any questions? Good! Here's a handy FAQ!


 What is Trivia Tricks Friend Pass?
‘Trivia Tricks Friend Pass’ is a free Steam download that will allow anyone to join ‘Trivia Tricks’ games via a room code.

 How do I get Friend Pass?
Friend Pass will be available to download through Steam, either as a ‘demo’ to Trivia Tricks or as a separate application (details to be finalized).

 How many people can play?
Up to 7 players can join an online lobby through Friend Pass! Lobbies can mix and match any combination of full game owners, Friend Pass users, and local players.

 Do you have to be added as a ‘friend’ on Steam to join the lobby?
Nope! Friend Pass players can join any lobby once they know the room code! Handy for streamers!

 Is there a playtime limit?
Nope! Friend Pass players can play as much as they like!

 Is this a limited time event?
Nope! Friend Pass is a permanent addition to Trivia Tricks!

 Are there any limits to Friend Pass?
Friend Pass players will not be able to host games, but after joining an online lobby through a room code they will be able to play with the same settings as full game owners. This includes Workshop packs, Co-Op Vs Boss mode, and partaking in games with Twitch Chat!

Friend Pass players cannot create their own characters or unlock achievements. If a Friend Pass player later decides to purchase the full game then any progress made in Friend Pass will carry over into the full game. This includes cosmetics, statistics and achievements (any earned achievements will unlock on Steam as soon as the full game is loaded).

Do note, because of the way Steam separates play time between full games and demos, Steam Trading Card drops (available soon) will only be available when playing the full game.

 What will happen to Steam Remote Play?
Trivia Tricks will continue to support Steam Remote Play as a way to join friends or connect extra controllers. However, we’ve had feedback from players that we should simplify the experience of sharing Trivia Tricks with others - we will therefore be removing the references to Steam Remote Play from Trivia Tricks’ How to Play menus. Remote Play will continue to work as it does today and improve with Valve’s updates to the service.

 Will the release of Friend Pass be the final Early Access update?
Friend Pass is the final major milestone that we will be releasing in Early Access, but we have some extra features and polish planned before Trivia Tricks graduates into full release!

And once Trivia Tricks hits launch day the updates won't stop! More updates are planned for Trivia Tricks even after launch, so stay tuned for more exciting news!

 My question isn’t answered here!
That’s not a question!... But that’s fine! Join the Trivia Tricks Discord to ask your question to the development team directly!


{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38882980/fd9dd2e889701f717ecaa9dd0a2c59cb5044167e.png

Throughout the span of two and a half years Trivia Tricks has received a frequent stream of content updates including Co-Op Vs Boss Mode, Seasonal Events and Steam Workshop Support while remaining at the same price. This pricing was chosen to reward players who put their trust in us to deliver our Early Access promises, and to thank those who have offered their invaluable feedback during development.

Trivia Tricks now represents more value than it did in 2020 and with the launch of Friend Pass the price of the full game will increase to be in-line with this added value. Once Friend Pass becomes available on [strike]June 1st![/strike] (Friend Pass now launches on May 30th!), Trivia Tricks will be priced at $14.99 / £12.79 / €14.79. This will be the base price of Trivia Tricks upon leaving Early Access too.

We would like to thank all our fans who have supported us during Early Access, without you Trivia Tricks would not have been possible! If you’re interested in hosting Trivia Tricks lobbies or creating your own custom characters then Trivia Tricks’ current price is the cheapest that it will be available for the foreseeable future. Don’t miss it!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38882980/50d3c2b8898b0fb3a0708bef6de1cd11d35c40fd.png

Hello Tricksters!

Here’s those patch notes in full!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38882980/d7c791aa87dd5f9ac7e9c03fbfec4db6fc699404.png

 Players told us that the Workshop “Download” step could do with some performance and usability improvements, so that’s what we’ve focused development on this week!
 Previously all players in a lobby had to finish downloading a pack before any players would move onto downloading the next pack, this has been change to allow players to download at their own pace. This should hugely decrease the time before a game starts, especially in lobbies where many Workshop packs are enabled.
 The "Download taking a while?" message was showing up too soon for players on slow connections downloading large packs, so we’ve extended the time before it appears.
 Added a "Retry" button which appears at the same time as the "Download taking a while?" message. This allows downloads to be retried without having to return to the lobby and ready up again.
 Fixed a bug where the ‘verify’ step could take place before downloads were fully complete, causing verification to fail.
 We’ve added automatic retries when the ‘verifying’ step fails on issues that can be resolved in time, this means verification should be more reliable.
 The progress bars in the Workshop Download menu are now animated when they increase and decrease instead of suddenly filling. Nifty!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38882980/d3b5f2dba5ff23cfa66099a8619b82f95417a15f.png

notes.title: Changes to Vs Boss Mode: Team Communication!
notes.notes:
Hey everyone!

We're back this week with our eighth regular update! This week we were implementing changes to Co-Op Vs Boss mode to make it easier to communicate as a team!

https://i.imgur.com/XJHVPSx.png

With this update comes a solution to make communicating with your team in Co-Op Vs Boss mode as easy as can be. We've added notches to the answers on screen to show who has selected an answer. You can also now change your answer as many times as you like. Pull the trigger too early on a guess but your friend actually watched that film? Now you can easily switch and earn your team some points. We hope this makes it easier for everyone to work together and help your attempts in taking on The King!

https://i.imgur.com/a9MxYaG.png

Coming to the character creator this week is also a new shirt with a cute little snake on it. This shirt is dedicated to 'Fangs' - a friend's snake who sadly is no longer with us but will be remembered fondly.

There are also some improvements this week to game lobbies based on feedback from the community and watching our lovely streamers.

You can find the patch notes to Trivia Tricks version 0.8.10.0 below:

Visible and Changing Answers!

Answers are now made visible via notches in Co-Op Vs Boss mode to help communicate as a team.
 You can now change your answer as many times as you like when playing in Co-Op Vs Boss mode.

Lobby Improvements!

 As the host of a lobby you can now kick players.
 When 60% of players ready up the game will now count down 60 seconds before automatically starting.

Misc Changes!

 When playing online with a guest, they will now use the name of their selected character, and not the Steam accounts' name. (Example: 'Mr. Tricks (1)' will now be known as 'Trinity').
 After answering players can now use the answer buttons/keys to emote faster. (Please note that you cannot use emotes in Co-Op Vs Boss because you will change your answer!)
A new free shirt is available for all players, the Fangs shirt!
Pressing Start in the Character Select Screen will now also join a player.
 Added community written questions submitted via Discord.
 Updated our question database to fix a range of typos and issues.

Bugs Squashed

 Fixed an issue where clicking to leave a game sometimes would not work depending on mouse placement when the menu opened.
 Fixed an issue where clicking to answer a question sometimes would not work depending on mouse placement when the buttons appeared.
 Fixed guest podium names displaying a different player's name when playing online with a guest.


Next week we will be focusing on general fixes and polish in a number of areas based off of community feedback.

Please let us know what you think on our Steam Discussion Forum or join our ever-growing Discord. Thank you for following Trivia Tricks!

notes.title: More Questions, Bug Fixes and the Future of Boss Mode!
notes.notes:
Hey everybody! We hope you all had a lovely festive period and are staying safe this winter!

For our 6th regular update we have concluded our Trivia Snowdown winter event and must sadly say goodbye to our Vs Boss mode - but not for long! Due to the exceptionally positive feedback the mode has received we have decided to make it a permanent feature, and we will be reimplementing the Vs Boss mode over the next week, alongside making Trivia Tricks DRM-free!

Thank you to everybody who took part in the event and for all the helpful feedback kindly given to create a better co-op experience. Over the next couple of releases we will be looking into:


 Better ways to communicate and share what you think is the correct answer with the lobby without having to use the chat box. 
 Being free to veto categories against a Boss character.
 Making Boss characters more lively with a bit more personality.
 AI balancing and difficulty adjustments.
 Adding Achievements and cosmetics to reward beating Bosses.
 Other, smaller design feedback we have received in testing.


These changes and updates will be delivered regularly to meet our first goal on our roadmap towards leaving early access.

The full patch notes of this update are below, update 0.8.8.0!

The Trivia Snowdown event is over!

 The Festive category has been removed and questions migrated where suitable
 The Festive items have been removed from the shop for players that did not buy or earn them. Feel you missed out? Don't worry! There's always next year!
 The stage has been reverted to a pre-Festive state
 Players will no longer earn cookies after a game
 The Vs Boss mode has been temporarily hidden while we unbuckle it from the holidays
 The game will no longer wish players happy holidays on boot, but everybody still gets their Santa Hats!
 Once again, thank you for your feedback during this time and helping shape Trivia Tricks!


Question Database Updates

 The The following categories have been significantly expanded for questions - Anime, Art & Literature, Film & TV, Language, Music, Science, and Video Games
 The following categories feature additional questions - Animals, Food & Drink, Geography, History, and Sports
 Fixed many question typos (Thank you to all of you for reporting these!)
 We would like to thank the Discord community for their question suggestions over the last week and you can now find these questions in-game!


 Bug Fixes

 Fixed an issue in the lobby settings where the lobby rules could be adjusted as the game was starting
 Fixed an issue in the lobby settings where the ‘Streak’ text did not highlight when hovered
 Fixed an issue in the lobby settings where the tickboxes were not highlighting on hover in all appropriate states
